from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentMatch(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single document's extracted title and identified cause of action."""
    doc_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g. '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action identified in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentMatch]
